mapper.sql:
l.live_broadcast_id, l.member_id, l.title, l.description, l.status, l.livekit_room_name, l.started_at, l.ended_at, l.view_count, l.created_at, l.updated_at,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auction a WHERE a.live_broadcast_id = l.live_broadcast_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AS item_count, (SELECT p.title FROM auction a JOIN product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.live_broadcast_id = l.live_broadcast_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.auction_id LIMIT 1) AS first_item_title, (SELECT p.thumbnail_url FROM auction a JOIN product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.live_broadcast_id = l.live_broadcast_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.auction_id LIMIT 1) AS first_item_thumbnail_url
mapper.select: SELECT FROM live_broadcast l WHERE l.status IN ('LIVE', 'SCHEDULED') ORDER BY CASE l.status WHEN 'LIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, l.view_count DESC, l.live_broadcast_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM live_broadcast l WHERE l.status = 'LIVE' ORDER BY l.view_count DESC, l.live_broadcast_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
